operations.description: List of Orphan URLs. URLs which generated visits from the selected source according to Google Analytics data, but were not crawled with by the Botify crawler (either because no links to them were found on the website, or because the crawler was not allowed to follow these links according to the project settings).   For a search engine (medium: origanic; sources: all, aol, ask, baidu, bing, google, naver, yahoo, yandex) or a social network (medium: social; sources: all, facebook, google+, linkedin, pinterest, reddit, tumblr, twitter)
operations.summary: List of Orphan URLs
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ganalytics orphan ur ls [PATH] analyses features ganalytics orphan urls [PARAMS] analysis medium page project size slug source username [SCHEMA] crawl ls orphan ur
